buildCommand:
git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 && export PATH="$PATH:$(pwd)/flutter/bin" && printf 'FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID=%s
FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID=%s
FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET=%s
FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY=%s
FIREBASE_WEB_APP_ID=%s
FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN=%s
' "$FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID" "$FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID" "$FIREBASE_STORAGE_BUCKET" "$FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY" "$FIREBASE_WEB_APP_ID" "$FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN" > .env && flutter doctor && flutter config --enable-web && flutter build web --release
